headline: Committee recommends Bill 83 on first reading, 9-0, and discusses Hālau funds and grants

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: The committee recommended Bill 83 on first reading with nine ayes, moving $372,933 from the Sewer Fund to the open space fund for Central Maui Wastewater Facility land. It also discussed Bill 69 on grants and Hālau funding.
meeting.recap: The budget change would restore items cut from the contract, like kitchen equipment and rooftop solar.[[0:38:21]] Bill 69 would let County agencies pay grants upfront or in installments.[[1:16:30]] The committee recommended Bill 83 on first reading with nine ayes.[[1:49:04]] The chair said the church may put the land on the open market if the County does not act.[[2:06:06]] A council member's office will contact the family before first reading.[[2:24:54]] The chair will take it up at the next meeting.[[2:27:22]]
meeting.next: Staff will send the administration written questions on the Hālau funds, including a full cost breakdown, ahead of second reading. A management plan for the Hālau building will be brought back to the Council.

issues.oneLine: The committee backed moving $372,933 from the Sewer Fund to the open space fund for land needed for the Central Maui Wastewater Facility.
issues.why: The open space fund is limited to land conservation, so it must be repaid for the part of the parcel used for wastewater.
issues.brief: The parcel was first bought with open space money for about $5.2 million.[[#1]] The wastewater project needs 7.13 percent of the parcel, or 14.9 of its 209 acres.[[#2]] The committee recommended the bill on first reading with nine ayes.[[#3]]
